title: The Pentagon's counter-drone force has rolled out a new online marketplace for buying defensive tech
excerpt: Developed with Kaizen Laboratories, the new shop allows users to find systems based on price, features, performance reviews, and requirements.
content_html:
By Chris Panella

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The Pentagon's counter-drone task force and software company Kaizen Laboratories have developed a new online marketplace built to help users find and acquire systems for defending against uncrewed aerial systems.

The "Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems Marketplace" is a catalog that military, federal government, and law enforcement personnel can use to assess validated systems, from kinetic weapons to jammers, and submit requests to buy them.

It's an example of the Pentagon's push to make it faster and easier for troops and other government users to acquire commercially developed technology and get it into the field.

Kaizen was awarded a $15 million contract by the Joint Interagency Task Force-401 in May to build and operate the marketplace. The newly unveiled enhanced platform allows users to search systems by requirements, review performance data, compare capabilities and features, and purchase equipment.

Defense officials have said that online shops like the C-UAS Marketplace help bypass traditional weapons acquisition processes that can be slow, fragmented, and difficult for users to navigate. Companies have said the same.

"These are broken, disconnected application layer systems that are preventing real capability from being deployed at the edge as fast as possible, and as we all know, it's presenting a critical readiness problem for the armed forces," said Kaizen CEO Nikhil Reddy.

Reddy told reporters last week that "threats are changing so quickly, but the systems that we actually have, the software layer, the application layer used to discover, evaluate, acquire, procure these systems, is so far behind what it needs to be. And operators are losing time, and in some cases, there's a loss of life if we can't move fast enough."

The US war with Iran has demonstrated the need for cheaper and more prolific counter-UAS weapons and equipment. Both American and allied forces have expended large numbers of expensive munitions shooting down Iranian Shahed drones.

Iran's one-way attack drones, along with waves of missiles, have struck US and partner forces, resulting in both infrastructure damage and casualties. During the opening days of the war, six US soldiers were killed by a drone attack in Kuwait.

These attacks, along with the prevalence of drones in Russia's war against Ukraine, have underscored the need for layered defenses that can defeat these kinds of inexpensive threats without relying primarily on costly missiles.

"Drones are a defining threat of our time," Brig. Gen. Matt Ross, director of JIATF-401, said in a press statement. "The proliferation of small systems and small drones and the threat that they pose both to critical infrastructure and to defense critical assets requires us to move faster in this space."

"In order to address this threat, we are expanding the counter-UAS marketplace to allow us to share best practices and equipment globally," he said.

The new enhanced C-UAS Marketplace features a library of forms and permits, and a planning tool through which users can describe a threat, identify systems that meet their needs and budget, and receive AI-generated recommendations "across all aspects of the kill chain," Reddy said.

The current platform went live two weeks ago and was built from a blank slate in less than nine weeks, he added.

He said that some vendors with approved counter-UAS systems, such as Anduril and AeroVironment, have already put their products on the marketplace. Future vendors can send in product information for the task force's approval. US partners and allies will also be able to use the platform.

"JIATF-401 remains focused on delivering the right counter-UAS capabilities to the right users at the right time," US Army Maj. Mike Hapner, JIATF-401's C-UAS marketplace lead, said in a press statement.

"Our revolutionary marketplace, powered through our partnership with industry, creates a streamlined, trusted pathway for the Joint Force, domestic law enforcement, and our international partners to rapidly discover and acquire validated technologies," he said.

The counter-UAS shop bears some resemblance to Ukraine's combat technology marketplace, the Brave1 Market, an Amazon-style platform for drones and counter-drone capabilities. Local manufacturers post their products on the site, and Ukrainian military units buy them and leave reviews and ratings.

The Ukrainian defense ministry has said the average delivery time for in-stock products has fallen from 10 to 14 days to eight days for front-line troops.

content_html_zh:
作者：Chris Panella 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

五角大楼的反无人机特别工作组和软件公司 Kaizen Laboratories 开发了一个新的在线市场，旨在帮助用户寻找和获取用于防御无人飞行系统的系统。

“反无人机系统市场”是一个目录，军方、联邦政府和执法人员可以使用它来评估从动能武器到干扰器等经过验证的系统，并提交购买请求。

这是五角大楼努力让军队和其他政府用户更快、更轻松地获取商业开发技术并将其投入使用的一个例子。

Kaizen 在 5 月份获得了联合跨机构工作组 401 授予的价值 1500 万美元的合同，负责构建和运营该市场。 新推出的增强平台允许用户按要求搜索系统、查看性能数据、比较功能和特性以及购买设备。

国防官员表示，像反无人机市场这样的在线商店有助于绕过传统的武器采购流程，这些流程可能缓慢、分散且用户难以导航。 公司也表示了同样的态度。

Kaizen 首席执行官尼克尔·雷迪 (Nikhil Reddy) 表示：“这些是破损、断开连接的应用层系统，阻碍了真正的能力尽快部署在边缘，众所周知，这给武装部队带来了严重的战备问题。”

雷迪上周告诉记者，“威胁变化如此之快，但我们实际拥有的系统，即用于发现、评估、获取、采购这些系统的软件层和应用程序层，远远落后于它所需要的水平。 操作员正在浪费时间，在某些情况下，如果我们行动不够快，还会造成人员伤亡。”

美国与伊朗的战争表明需要更便宜、更多产的反无人机武器和装备。 美国和盟军都消耗了大量昂贵的弹药来击落伊朗沙赫德无人机。

伊朗的单向攻击无人机和一波又一波的导弹袭击了美国及其伙伴部队，造成基础设施损坏和人员伤亡。 战争初期，六名美国士兵在科威特的一次无人机袭击中丧生。

这些袭击，加上无人机在俄罗斯对乌克兰战争中的盛行，凸显了分层防御的必要性，这种防御可以在不主要依赖昂贵的导弹的情况下击败这些廉价的威胁。

“无人机是我们这个时代的决定性威胁，”准将说。 Gen. JIATF-401 主任马特·罗斯 (Matt Ross) 在一份新闻声明中表示。 “小型系统和小型无人机的扩散以及它们对关键基础设施和防御关键资产构成的威胁要求我们在这一领域加快行动。”

他说：“为了应对这一威胁，我们正在扩大反无人机市场，以便我们能够在全球范围内分享最佳实践和设备。”

雷迪说，新的增强型反无人机市场具有表格和许可证库以及规划工具，用户可以通过该工具描述威胁，识别满足其需求和预算的系统，并接收人工智能生成的“涵盖杀伤链各个方面”的建议。

他补充说，当前的平台于两周前上线，并在不到九周的时间内从空白开始构建。

他说，一些拥有经批准的反无人机系统的供应商，例如 Anduril 和 AeroVironment，已经将其产品投放市场。 未来的供应商可以发送产品信息以供工作组批准。 美国合作伙伴和盟友也将能够使用该平台。

“JIATF-401 仍然专注于在正确的时间向正确的用户提供正确的反无人机能力，”美国陆军少校。 JIATF-401 反无人机市场负责人迈克·哈普纳 (Mike Hapner) 在一份新闻声明中表示。

他说：“我们的革命性市场在我们与工业界的合作伙伴关系的推动下，为联合部队、国内执法部门和我们的国际合作伙伴快速发现和获取经过验证的技术创造了一条简化的、值得信赖的途径。”

反无人机商店与乌克兰的战斗技术市场 Brave1 市场有一些相似之处，这是一个亚马逊风格的无人机和反无人机功能平台。 当地制造商在网站上发布他们的产品，乌克兰军事单位购买它们并留下评论和评级。

乌克兰国防部表示，前线部队库存产品的平均交货时间已从 10 至 14 天缩短至 8 天。
